digest.component_or_area: LLM review gates (plan-review, code-review, completion-verification) and observability infrastructure
propositions: Per-gate LLM costs measured at plan-review $3.02, code-review $1.42, completion-verifier $2.24; per-completed-ticket mean $11.85 with median ~$8.15 and p90 ~$21.

Cheap-model experiments (Nova Pro, Haiku, Nova 2 Lite) showed Nova Pro at ~$0.10/run with 50-57% blocking-criteria recall but disqualified for 3 false-accepts on completion-verification; Haiku ranked second with zero false-accepts but 18% recall gap.

Code-review severity axes are inert not due to finding scarcity (2.48 findings/run, 183 marked major/critical) but due to blocking routing disabled on 98.2% of criteria, 0.95 threshold unreachable (max observed impact 0.90, p99 0.60, median gap 0.65), and only security path live with 51 findings.

Five new defects filed in observability.sh probe: cold-start offset seeding causes false metrics (widespread-zealous-narwhal), unanchored grep pattern matches LLM review prose as errors (colossal-slothful-grouse), both fire alarms on non-events; JIRA_API_TOKEN expiry produced zero bridge/reconcile alarms (coverage gap).

Deprecation audit found zero scheduled deprecations met removal conditions; only gitattributes migration arm (15 LOC) is expired; single-pass review surfaces (item 2, 42 refs) and REBAR_LLM_MODEL (item 3) are candidates for pre-1.0 breaking window but require operator approval.

Session logs consolidated to single durable location (cosey-vinegarish-mouflon) per operator anti-pattern ruling; no records deleted from append-only store, all durable evidence in shared ticket trail and published artifact; all three acceptance verification commands pass.
